description: Lint frame: pass, findings, fixes, a11y. Errors: invisible text, overflow, zero-size, LOW_CONTRAST, TARGET_TOO_SMALL (<24 px; warn <44). Warnings: TEXT_TOO_SMALL, misalignment, raw fills. CONTRAST_AAA: info (error: AAA).

checks.description: Restrict to these codes (default: all). CONTRAST_AA is an alias of LOW_CONTRAST.
